_comment: Maps free-text Vietnamese law names (as they appear in judgments / related_law_provisions) to the corpus law_id. Matching (implemented in src/alqac/data.py) is: (1) if an explicit code like '91/2015/QH13' or '326/2016' appears in the citation string -> match directly; (2) else normalise (lowercase, strip diacritics) and require ALL 'must' keywords present and NO 'must_not' keyword, optionally disambiguating by 'year'. Laws cited in gold but ABSENT from the corpus (e.g. Bộ luật Dân sự 2005 = 33/2005/QH11) are intentionally left unmapped — they cannot be cited by aid.
